Market today: Bond yields are spiking, and that's the real driver hitting your concentrated tech/chip book. It's a tough environment for leveraged names.

Your holdings: SMCI (-18.94%) and MU (-29.47%) are flagged for attention. SOXL (-54.06%) and SPAL (-26.04%) are also deep in the red, and given they are leveraged ETFs, they need careful watching, especially on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI's price action around the 35.43-35.37 entry zone from the scanner. Also, watch how the broader market reacts to the bond yield moves.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting capital in this rising yield environment.
plays: SMCI: Consider trimming if it breaks below the 35.09 scanner stop.
SOXL/SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are bleeding. Re-evaluate your risk tolerance and consider reducing exposure if they continue to fall.
